name: Everything Will Be Alright
source:
Miya is a university student in her final year who suffers from social anxiety. This is her journey of overcoming her social anxiety by herself as she returns to campus for the final semester of her studies. 

Will she be able to overcome it with no problem or will she keep hiding from the world's view to avoid being seen by people?

[From [url=https://ayraforyou.itch.io/everything-will-be-alright]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
米娅是一名患有社交焦虑症的大四学生。这是她在最后一个学期重返校园时独自克服社交焦虑的旅程。

她是否能够毫无问题地克服困难，还是会继续隐藏在世人的视野中，以免被人们看到？

[来自[url=https://ayraforyou.itch.io/everything-will-be-alright]Itch.io[/url]]
